content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge relies on the defender having dropped the targeted curse limb, not on any single verse failing to state a link or its contrary.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.","room":"single verse does not state a link or its contrary: whether the judge used single-verse insufficiency or the dropped live link as the ground.","why":"The judge's stated ground is the dropped limb and absence of a live link, not a single verse failing to state a link or its contrary."}
